events.title: Kids on the Move! Growing Gardens
events.description: How do Wave Hill's gardens grow? Through work, love, and the efforts of the Wave Hill team! During this month's Kids on the Move! go on a guided walk through the Garden with guest educator Corinne Flax and visit the compost pile to learn how gardeners take care of the Garden and keep everything looking tidy. Then, channel your inner garden guardian as you move your body like a variety of garden tools during a yoga-inspired movement practice.  Recommended for ages three to eight. Walks follow a variety of routes along mixed-material pathways and varying elevations. Pathways may include rugged terrain and steps. Registration not required. Severe weather cancels.  Spend the day! Families are encouraged to attend Family Art Project: Garden Guardians before the walk.   Questions? Please email us at information@wavehill.org or call 718.549.3200 x251.
